props.title: Seven PRs Merged Into Aeon In Two Minutes. Four Were From The Audit Bot. Three Were From Strangers.

props.text: The AntFleet audit queue that opened Monday night with 27 findings closed today at 1 remaining High. The 14:12-14:14 UTC merge batch absorbed four audit-bot PRs (H3/H4/H7/H9) plus three external contributor PRs — from forks that had existed for under 16 hours. Aeon also crossed 100 forks today.
